method: A unique match requires the normalized full title printed in the POW PDF first three pages to appear exactly in one HGAB 3rd-reading DPWH project title. Repeated titles are left ambiguous. A unique match outside the no-DPWH-Transparency-link cohort is identified but not added to the undocumented queue.
source: Senate-provided HGAB POW files and the full HGAB 3rd-reading DPWH project ledger.
